summary: New pricing page with detailed plans for Amp and Code Search

change_summary.what_changed: New pricing page with detailed plans for Amp and Code Search
specific_changes: Introduction of Amp pricing plans: Amp, Amp Teams, and Amp Enterprise
Code Search pricing plans: Enterprise Starter and Enterprise Search
Detailed features and limitations for each plan
FAQ section added for clarity on pricing and plans

strategic_analysis.business_impact: The new pricing strategy may attract more customers by offering tailored plans, but it also increases the complexity of the pricing structure.
market_signals: Sourcegraph is focusing on enterprise customers with the introduction of Amp Enterprise and Enterprise Search plans.
The company is emphasizing the importance of security, scalability, and flexibility in its pricing plans.
strategic_analysis.competitive_implications: The updated pricing strategy may put pressure on competitors to revisit their pricing models and offer more tailored plans to customers.
strategic_analysis.strategic_direction: Sourcegraph is likely to continue investing in its enterprise offerings, given the introduction of new plans and features catering to large dev teams.

pricing: Amp: $10 free credit trial, at-cost pricing
Amp Teams: $10 free credit trial per user, at-cost pricing, single sign-on
Amp Enterprise: $10 free credit trial per user, 50% more expensive than individual and Team usage, single sign-on, zero LLM retention
Enterprise Starter: $19 per user, monthly, up to 50 devs
Enterprise Search: $49 per user, monthly, 25+ devs

key_findings: Sourcegraph's pricing strategy has become more complex with the introduction of multiple plans.
The company is targeting different customer segments with its pricing plans.
opportunities: Sourcegraph may attract more enterprise customers with its new pricing plans.
The company can leverage its updated pricing strategy to increase revenue.
threats: The increased complexity of the pricing structure may confuse customers.
Competitors may respond by introducing similar pricing plans, increasing competition.
recommended_actions: Monitor customer feedback on the new pricing plans.
Analyze the impact of the pricing strategy on revenue and customer acquisition.
